notable.name: Miskito
notable.note: spoken in the eastern Mosquito Coast region

terrainDescription.zh: 中央多山，境內大部分為山地地形；東部莫斯基提亞海岸為低地熱帶雨林；加勒比海岸線長，太平洋僅有豐塞卡灣一小段出海口。
terrainDescription.en: Predominantly mountainous through the interior; the eastern La Mosquitia coast is lowland rainforest; a long Caribbean coastline contrasts with just a small Pacific outlet at the Gulf of Fonseca.

plate.color: white background, black text; blue identification band, Honduras map outline, "Centro América" slogan (redesign since 2018)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Not well documented — no confirmed distinctive national style found

utilityPole.transformerMount: Not strongly documented for Honduras specifically

historicalContext.zh: 官方語言為西班牙語，加勒比海岸另有非裔加勒比原住民加里富納語與米斯基托語社群；道路標誌採用中美洲共通的 MUTCD 式區域標準，距離以公里計算。
historicalContext.en: Spanish is official, though Afro-Indigenous Garifuna and Miskito language communities persist along the Caribbean coast. Road signage follows the shared Central American MUTCD-derived regional standard, with distances in kilometers.
